name: pso-bench
description: A collection of benchmark functions and problem instances intended for evaluating particle-swarm/black-box optimization algorithms. It provides diverse test problems (different functions, dimensions, and noise settings) so researchers can compare optimization performance (best-found value, regret, convergence) across algorithms. The dataset is primarily intended for algorithmic optimization research rather than language or vision tasks.
evaluation_method: best-found objective value / simple regret (optimization performance)
typical_sota_score: varies by function and dimension; no single unified SOTA
reputation: Niche dataset used by optimization researchers and practitioners; modest adoption relative to mainstream ML benchmarks.
